auth.label: API Key

actions.name: list_am_reports
actions.description: List Wisburg asset-management research reports (资管报告) with cursor pagination, keyword search, and time filters.

first.description: The number of items per page, up to 100. Defaults to 20.

after.description: The pagination cursor from `pageInfo.endCursor` of the previous page.

query.description: The search keyword. Without a keyword items are sorted by publication time descending; with one by relevance.

startTime.description: The start of the time range as a Unix timestamp or an ISO 8601 string.

endTime.description: The end of the time range as a Unix timestamp or an ISO 8601 string.

inputSchema.description: Pagination, keyword, and time-range filters supported by Wisburg list endpoints.

requestId.description: The Wisburg request ID used for troubleshooting.

datetime.description: The publication time in ISO 8601 format.

items.description: A Wisburg research report list item.
Research reports on this page.

endCursor.description: The cursor for the next page; absent when there is no next page.

pageInfo.description: Cursor pagination details for the current page.

outputSchema.description: A page of Wisburg research reports.
